acceptance_criteria_verified.name: Role-Based Access Control for Announcement Publishing, Editing, Deleting, and Pinning
acceptance_criteria_verified.evidence: 403 Forbidden verified for runner on POST /api/clubs/sarc-sadc/posts, PUT /api/clubs/sarc-sadc/posts/:id, PUT /api/clubs/sarc-sadc/posts/:id/pin, DELETE /api/clubs/sarc-sadc/posts/:id. UI verified: Add announcement button and Edit/Delete/Pin buttons hidden for runner, visible for captain.

acceptance_criteria_verified.name: Runner Personal Hide Capability with LocalStorage Persistence
acceptance_criteria_verified.evidence: Personal [👁️ Ẩn tin] button verified on runner view. Clicking hide removes post from main feed, decrements badge, and persists to openrace_hidden_posts in localStorage.

acceptance_criteria_verified.name: Filter tabs for Expired Announcements archive and Hidden Announcements archive with Unhide support
acceptance_criteria_verified.evidence: post-filter-expired displays post-4 with expired badge. post-filter-hidden displays hidden post-1 with [👁️ Bỏ Ẩn] button. Clicking unhide restores post to main feed and clears from localStorage.
